spans.s: + कक्ष्य सुवर्ण- + कक्ष्य, adj. having a golden girth,
+ कर्तृ सु-वर्ण- + कर्तृ, m. a goldsmith.

+ विक्रान्त सु- + विक्रान्त,
 I. m. a hero.
 II. n. heroism.
+ ग्रन्थि सुवर्ण- + ग्रन्थि, m. a knot made for keeping gold, Pañc. 134, 12.
+ पुष्पित सुवर्ण- + पुष्पित, adj. having gold instead of flowers, Pañc. i. d. 51 (but cf. Böhtl. Ind.
+ वचन सु- + वचन, n. eloquence.
+ वचस् सु- + वचस्, adj. speaking well or much.
+ वदन सु- + वदन, adj., f. ना, beautiful, Ṛt. 6, 20.

+ वर्ण सु- + वर्ण,
 I. adj. 1. of a good colour. 2. brilliant. 3. of a good tribe.
 II. n. 1. gold, Pañc. 191, 25. 2. wealth.
 III. m. and n. a weight of gold equal to sixteen Māṣas, i. e. about seventy-five grains Troy,

; a sort of coin, Pañc. 134, 3.
 IV. m. 1. a sort of sacrifice. 2. a tree, Cassia fistula.
 V. f. णा, the name of several plants.
+ वसन सु- + वसन, adj., f. ना, elegantly attired, Johns.
+ वसन्त सु- + वसन्त, m. the day of full moon in the month Caitra, a festival in honour of Kāma.
+ वासित सु- + वासित, adj. well perfumed, Ṛt. 1, 3.
+ वास सु- + वास, m. 1. a pleasant dwelling. 2. an agreeable perfume.

+ वासिन् सु- + वासिन्,
 I. adj. dwelling comfortably.
 II. f. नी, a bride residing in her father's house,
+ विचक्षण सु- + विचक्षण, adj. well-discerning, Hit. i. d. 21, M.M.
+ विचार सु- + विचार, m. due consideration.
+ विज्ञान सु- + विज्ञान, adj. very wise, Pañc. iii. d. 117.

+ विध सु- + विध,
 I. adj. 1. of a good kind. 2. in a good or easy way.
 II. ˚धम्, adv. easily.
+ विन्दु सुवर्ण- + विन्दु (m.), Viṣṇu,
Mālat. 166, 16
; the name of a holy place,
Mālat. 145, 6
+ विपुल सु- + विपुल, adj. very spacious.
+ विभीषण सु- + विभीषण, adj. very terrible,
+ विलय सु- + विलय, adj. easily fusible.
+ म् सु-विस्तर + म्, adv. at large,

+ वीर सु- + वीर,
 I. adj. abounding in heroes.
 II. m. pl. the name of a people,
Draup. 8, 9
+ वीर्य सु- + वीर्य, n. 1. great vigour. 2. abundance in heroes,
+ वृत्त सु- + वृत्त, adj. 1. virtuous, good, Pañc. ii. d. 74. 2. handsomely round, Pañc. iv. d. 78; i. d. 303. 3. well-conditioned, Pañc. ii. d. 74.
सु-वेम, m. a good loom,
+ विद्ध सु- + विद्ध, adj. deeply wounded, Ṛt. 6, 28. Anomal. infin. वेद्धुम् (from विध्, for व्यध्, based on विध्य),
+ वीत सु- + वीत, adj. well covered,

+ व्रत सु- + व्रत,
 I. adj. rigidly observing any religious vow or obligation, virtuous,

.
 II. f. ता. 1. a virtuous wife. 2. a cow easily milked. 3. a proper name, Śāk. 102, 22 (Prākṛ.).
+ विश्वस्त सु- + विश्वस्त, adj. 1. confidential. 2. without any suspicion, Pañc. 34, 25.
+ सिद्ध सुवर्ण- + सिद्ध, m. an adept who has acquired gold (by magical means), Pañc. 243, 1, sqq.

सु-वर्च् + अल,
 I. m. A country so named.
 II. f. ला.
 1. The wife of the sun.
 2. Linseed.
 --Comp.
सु-वर्चस् + अ, adj. Shining brightly,
सु-वर्ण + मय, adj., f. यी, Golden, Pañc. 192, 16.
सु-विद् + अ, m. A guard or attendant on the womens' apartment.
सु-विद् + अत्र, n. A household.

सुविदल्ल,
 I. n. A haram.
 II. f. ला, A woman.
सुवृक्ति, i. e. सु-वृज् + ति, f. A hymn,
सु-विस्तीर्ण, adj. very large,
+ विस्मित सु- + विस्मित, adj. much surprised, Pañc. 41, 21.
